name: Event Tickets
description: Ticket types for events with quantity caps: public purchase generates unique ticket codes (instantly for free tickets, after manual payment confirmation for paid ones), emails them, and provides an attendee list with check-in by code.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read events, ticket types, orders, tickets and attendee check-in state.
Create the plugin tables and write events, ticket types, orders, generated ticket codes and check-ins.
Read the plugin configuration (currency symbol, manual payment instructions, notification email).
Save the plugin configuration from the admin page.
Public endpoints for the ticket block (events, order, order status) and admin endpoints (CRUD, payment confirmation, check-in, CSV export).
Add the 'Entradas' entry to the admin sidebar.
Email ticket codes to buyers and notify the site owner about new orders.
